meta.description.en: Qwen3.5-27B is a dense hybrid Mamba-Transformer multimodal model (gated delta networks + full attention, 27B parameters, 262144-token context, MTP head). This recipe covers its W8A8 and BF16 Ascend deployment on Atlas 800 A2/A3 and Atlas 300I DUO.
meta.description.zh: Qwen3.5-27B 是 Qwen3.5 系列的稠密混合 Mamba-Transformer 多模态模型（门控 delta 网络 + 全注意力，27B 参数，262144 token 上下文，带 MTP 头）。本配方覆盖其在 Atlas 800 A2/A3 与 Atlas 300I DUO 上的 W8A8 与 BF16 昇腾部署。

meta.performance_headline.en: DP-first W8A8 (TP=2) or BF16 on Atlas 800 A3/A2; TP-only FP16 path on Atlas 300I DUO
meta.performance_headline.zh: 以 DP 优先的 W8A8（TP=2）或 BF16 部署于 Atlas 800 A3/A2；Atlas 300I DUO 仅支持 TP 的 FP16 路径

model.install.docker.note.en: Pinned Ascend image; the full per-SKU device and driver mounts are listed in env_setup.
model.install.docker.note.zh: 固定版本的昇腾镜像；各 SKU 完整的设备与驱动挂载见 env_setup。

features.spec_decoding.description.en: MTP speculative decoding (qwen3_5_mtp, 3 tokens) — both Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.6-27B share this MTP head
features.spec_decoding.description.zh: MTP 投机解码（qwen3_5_mtp，3 个 token）—— Qwen3.5-27B 与 Qwen3.6-27B 共用同一套 MTP 头

features.compilation_config.description.en: Full ACL graph execution in decode (--compilation-config cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY)
features.compilation_config.description.zh: decode 阶段全量 ACL Graph 执行（--compilation-config cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY）

features.async_scheduling.description.en: Asynchronous scheduling to overlap CPU scheduling with NPU computation
features.async_scheduling.description.zh: 异步调度，让 CPU 调度与 NPU 计算重叠

features.cpu_binding.description.en: Pin Ascend worker threads and NPU IRQs to the CPU ranges closest to the driven NPU
features.cpu_binding.description.zh: 把昇腾 worker 线程与 NPU 中断绑定到离所驱动 NPU 最近的 CPU 范围

variants.default.description.en: ModelSlim W8A8 checkpoint with the MTP head; the recommended default on Atlas 800 A2/A3
variants.default.description.zh: 带 MTP 头的 ModelSlim W8A8 权重；Atlas 800 A2/A3 上的推荐默认项

variants.bf16.description.en: Full-precision BF16 weights (~55.6 GB) — needs TP=2 on 64 GB dies
variants.bf16.description.zh: 全精度 BF16 权重（约 55.6 GB）—— 在 64 GB 单 die 上需要 TP=2

variants.p310.description.en: Same W8A8 MTP checkpoint on Atlas 300I DUO, which only supports TP and requires FP16 runtime
variants.p310.description.zh: 同一份 W8A8 MTP 权重用于 Atlas 300I DUO：该平台只支持 TP，且必须 FP16 运行

config_params.max_model_len.description.en: Maximum context length (input + output tokens); the model supports up to 262144
config_params.max_model_len.description.zh: 最大上下文长度（输入 + 输出 token）；模型上限为 262144

config_params.max_num_seqs.description.en: Maximum number of concurrent sequences per DP group
config_params.max_num_seqs.description.zh: 每个 DP 组允许的最大并发序列数

overview.en:
Qwen3.5-27B is the flagship dense model of the Qwen3.5 family. It uses gated delta networks (linear attention) with a full-attention layer every fourth block, accepts text plus image/video input, serves a 262144-token context, and ships an MTP head that backs `qwen3_5_mtp` speculative decoding.

On Ascend, the deployment principle is **DP-first**: the W8A8 checkpoint is roughly 30 GB and fits on a single 64 GB die, so keep TP=2 and spend the remaining dies on data parallelism. TP=8 is only for 256K+ context, where sharding the KV cache across eight dies is what buys the window.
overview.zh:
Qwen3.5-27B 是 Qwen3.5 系列的旗舰稠密模型。它采用门控 delta 网络（线性注意力），每四个 block 插入一层全注意力，支持文本与图像/视频输入，原生 262144 token 上下文，并带 MTP 头支撑 `qwen3_5_mtp` 投机解码。

在昇腾上的部署原则是 **DP 优先**：W8A8 权重约 30 GB，单张 64 GB die 即可容纳，因此保持 TP=2，把其余 die 全部分给数据并行。TP=8 只用于 256K+ 上下文——此时把 KV cache 切分到 8 张 die 才是拿到该窗口的手段。

quantization.content.en:
The container image ships a pre-quantized W8A8 build under the `Eco-Tech/` namespace on ModelScope: `Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp`. It carries the MTP head, so speculative decoding works without a separate draft model. Quantized weights must be started with `--quantization ascend`; drop the flag to serve BF16 (`Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B`).

Atlas 300I DUO has no BF16 path: it runs the same W8A8 checkpoint with `--dtype float16` and `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float16`.
quantization.content.zh:
镜像生态中提供预量化 W8A8 权重，位于 ModelScope 的 `Eco-Tech/` 命名空间：`Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp`。它自带 MTP 头，因此投机解码无需额外的 draft 模型。量化权重必须带 `--quantization ascend` 启动；去掉该参数即服务 BF16（`Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B`）。

Atlas 300I DUO 没有 BF16 路径：它运行同一份 W8A8 权重，但必须 `--dtype float16` 且 `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float16`。

prerequisites[0].content.en:
- **Atlas 800 A3** (64 GB × 16): one node. The 16-NPU layout is TP=2 + DP=8.
- **Atlas 800 A2** (64 GB × 8): one node. The 8-NPU layout is TP=2 + DP=4.
- **Atlas 300I DUO**: at least two devices; only TP is supported (TP=2 or TP=4), FP16 runtime only.
prerequisites[0].content.zh:
- **Atlas 800 A3**（64 GB × 16）：单节点。16 NPU 布局为 TP=2 + DP=8。
- **Atlas 800 A2**（64 GB × 8）：单节点。8 NPU 布局为 TP=2 + DP=4。
- **Atlas 300I DUO**：至少 2 张卡；只支持 TP（TP=2 或 TP=4），且只能 FP16 运行。

prerequisites[1].content.en: `min_vllm_version` is `0.30.0`. Qwen3.5-27B is first supported in `vllm-ascend:v0.17.0rc1` and Atlas 300I DUO support starts at `v0.23.0rc1`, but this recipe's rendered commands are validated only against the v0.30.0 image line.
prerequisites[1].content.zh: `min_vllm_version` 为 `0.30.0`。Qwen3.5-27B 自 `vllm-ascend:v0.17.0rc1` 起获得支持，Atlas 300I DUO 支持自 `v0.23.0rc1` 起；但本配方渲染出的命令只在 v0.30.0 镜像线上验证。

env_setup.pip.content.en:
There is no Ascend wheel on PyPI, so a source build is the only pip path:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend.git
cd vllm-ascend
pip install -e .
```

Verify:
```bash
pip show vllm-ascend
```

昇腾侧 PyPI 没有对应轮子，pip 路径只能源码构建：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend.git
cd vllm-ascend
pip install -e .
```

验证：
```bash

```

env_setup.container.Atlas 800 A2.content.en:
```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.30.0
docker run --rm \
    --name vllm-ascend \
    --shm-size=1g \
    --net=host \
    --device /dev/davinci0 --device /dev/davinci1 --device /dev/davinci2 --device /dev/davinci3 \
    --device /dev/davinci4 --device /dev/davinci5 --device /dev/davinci6 --device /dev/davinci7 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager --device /dev/devmm_svm --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/ \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -v /root/.cache:/root/.cache \
    -it $IMAGE bash
```

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
**Status: experimental.** The tutorial's Atlas 800 A2 layout assumes 64 GB dies (64G × 8). This repository's A2 verification runner is an Atlas 800I A2 with **910B4 parts (32 GB per die)**, where the 133k-context W8A8 configuration does not fit: weights take ~15 GB per die and the KV cache pushes the die past 32 GB, so the engines never become ready. The command below keeps the tutorial topology (TP2 + DP4) but caps `--max-model-len` at 32768 so it can run on these 32 GB dies; use the tutorial's 133000 on 64 GB A2 hardware.

```bash
#!/bin/sh
export MODEL_PATH=Eco-Tech/Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp
export VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE=True
export VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT=1800
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=512
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1

vllm serve $MODEL_PATH \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 8000 \
    --data-parallel-size 4 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
    --quantization ascend \
    --served-model-name qwen3.5 \
    --max-num-seqs {{max_num_seqs}} \
    --max-model-len 32768 \
    --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --allowed-local-media-path / \
    --dtype bfloat16 \
    --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
    --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 \
    --mm-encoder-tp-mode data \
    --mm-processor-cache-type shm \
    --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
    {{prefix_caching}} \
    {{spec_decoding}} \
    {{compilation_config}} \
    {{cpu_binding}} \
    {{async_scheduling}}
```

tuning.en:
### Parallelism strategy (DP-first)

`Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8` is roughly 30 GB, so it fits on a single 64 GB HBM die. Keep **TP=2** as the default and give the remaining dies to DP for parallel request batches. **TP=8 is only for 256K+ context**, where sharding the KV cache across eight dies is what makes the window reachable.

**Atlas 300I DUO**: TP only — TP=2 or TP=4, FP16 runtime, `--max-model-len` capped at 16384 here (raise it only after checking HBM headroom).

| Scenario | Deployment | NPUs | Weight | Notes |
|----------|------------|------|--------|-------|
| High Throughput (128K ctx) | Single-Node A2 | 8 | Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp | TP=2 + DP=4 — uses all 8 NPUs for parallel request batches |
| High Throughput (128K ctx) | Single-Node A3 | 16 | Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp | TP=2 + DP=8 — uses all 16 NPUs for parallel request batches |
| Low Latency (128K ctx) | Single-Node A3 | 16 | Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp | TP=2 + DP=8, `--max-num-seqs 4` — lower per-layer Allreduce overhead for small interactive batches |
| Long Context (256K+ ctx) | Single-Node A3 | 16 | Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp | TP=8 + DP=2 — shards the KV cache across 8 NPUs |
| Short context, FP16 | Single-Node 300I DUO | 2-8 | Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp | TP=2 or TP=4, `--dtype float16` |

| Scenario | Config | TP | DP | Max Num Seqs | Max Num Batched Tokens | Max Model Len | MTP Num | Async Scheduling |
|----------|--------|----|----|--------------|------------------------|---------------|---------|-------------------|
| High Throughput (128K) | Single-Node A2 | 2 | 4 | 32 | 16384 | 133000 | 3 | On |
| High Throughput (128K) | Single-Node A3 | 2 | 8 | 32 | 16384 | 133120 | 3 | On |
| Low Latency (128K) | Single-Node A3 | 2 | 8 | 4 | 4096 | 133120 | 3 | On |
| Long Context (256K+) | Single-Node A3 | 8 | 2 | 8 | 8192 | 262144 | 3 | On |
| Short context | Single-Node 300I DUO | 2-4 | 1 | 128 | 8192 | 16384 | 1 | Off |

### Key levers

- `--gpu-memory-utilization`: raise it to grow the KV cache; too high risks OOM because the warm-up peak differs from steady-state usage.
- `--max-num-batched-tokens`: larger means lower latency but more activation HBM.
- `--speculative-config`: both Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.6-27B use `qwen3_5_mtp`; on Atlas 300I DUO set `num_speculative_tokens` to 1.
- `--compilation-config cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY`: recommended; `PIECEWISE` is the alternative. On Atlas 300I DUO use at most two capture sizes.
- `--additional-config '{"enable_cpu_binding": true}'`: pins threads and NPU IRQs near the driven NPU; on by default from v0.18.0rc1.
tuning.zh:
### 并行策略（DP 优先）

`Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8` 约 30 GB，单张 64 GB HBM die 即可容纳。默认保持 **TP=2**，把其余 die 分给 DP 以并行处理请求批次。**TP=8 只用于 256K+ 上下文**——此时把 KV cache 切到 8 张 die 才是拿到该窗口的手段。

**Atlas 300I DUO**：只支持 TP —— TP=2 或 TP=4，FP16 运行；此处 `--max-model-len` 保守取 16384（确认 HBM 余量后再上调）。

| 场景 | 部署 | NPU 数 | 权重 | 说明 |
|------|------|--------|------|------|
| 高吞吐（128K 上下文） | 单节点 A2 | 8 | Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp | TP=2 + DP=4 —— 8 张 NPU 全部用于并行请求批次 |
| 高吞吐（128K 上下文） | 单节点 A3 | 16 | Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp | TP=2 + DP=8 —— 16 张 NPU 全部用于并行请求批次 |
| 低时延（128K 上下文） | 单节点 A3 | 16 | Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp | TP=2 + DP=8、`--max-num-seqs 4` —— 小批量交互场景下每层 Allreduce 开销更低 |
| 长上下文（256K+） | 单节点 A3 | 16 | Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp | TP=8 + DP=2 —— KV cache 切分到 8 张 NPU |
| 短上下文、FP16 | 单节点 300I DUO | 2-8 | Qwen3.5-27B-w8a8-mtp | TP=2 或 TP=4，`--dtype float16` |

| 场景 | 配置 | TP | DP | Max Num Seqs | Max Num Batched Tokens | Max Model Len | MTP 数 | 异步调度 |
|------|------|----|----|--------------|------------------------|---------------|--------|----------|
| 高吞吐（128K） | 单节点 A2 | 2 | 4 | 32 | 16384 | 133000 | 3 | 开 |
| 高吞吐（128K） | 单节点 A3 | 2 | 8 | 32 | 16384 | 133120 | 3 | 开 |
| 低时延（128K） | 单节点 A3 | 2 | 8 | 4 | 4096 | 133120 | 3 | 开 |
| 长上下文（256K+） | 单节点 A3 | 8 | 2 | 8 | 8192 | 262144 | 3 | 开 |
| 短上下文 | 单节点 300I DUO | 2-4 | 1 | 128 | 8192 | 16384 | 1 | 关 |

### 关键调节项

- `--gpu-memory-utilization`：调大以扩大 KV cache；过高会 OOM，因为预热阶段峰值与稳态占用并不相同。
- `--max-num-batched-tokens`：调大降低时延，但激活值 HBM 压力上升。
- `--speculative-config`：Qwen3.5-27B 与 Qwen3.6-27B 都使用 `qwen3_5_mtp`；Atlas 300I DUO 上把 `num_speculative_tokens` 设为 1。
- `--compilation-config cudagraph_mode=FULL_DECODE_ONLY`：推荐值，`PIECEWISE` 为备选。Atlas 300I DUO 上最多使用两个 capture size。
- `--additional-config '{"enable_cpu_binding": true}'`：把线程与 NPU 中断绑到最近 NUMA 域；自 v0.18.0rc1 起默认开启。
